# RAM map and cross-reference (generated by tools/xref.py - do not edit)

Name, meaning and how sure we are come from game/ram_map.py (live = checked in the running
game by tools/verify_ram.py; code = read from the code; guess = a working idea). The last two
columns are every instruction in the ROM that touches the byte, found by tracing the code from
the reset vector. `,X` means the byte is the base of a table the code indexes into, so the
bytes after it are touched too. Routines are named by their address ($Fxxx).

| RAM | name | meaning | sure | written by | read by |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| $80 | DEATH_TIMER | $FF when a monster catches you, counts down to 0 while the eyes roll (monsters keep walking, but don't chase); at 0 the monsters are scattered and play goes on, or the game ends if no lives are left | live | F141 (STA)<br>F8AC (DEC)<br>FA90 (STX) | F2B7 (LDA)<br>F59E (LDA)<br>F8AC (DEC, LDA)<br>FA90 (LDA) |
| $81 | DROP_TRIES | 5 when an item is dropped, counts down while the game looks for a free spot for it next to the player | code | FB68 (STA)<br>FBE2 (DEC, STA) | F2B7 (LDX)<br>F526 (LDY)<br>FA90 (LDA)<br>FB68 (LDA)<br>FBE2 (DEC, LDX, LDY) |
| $82 | MATCHES_USED | matches lit this game, BCD (the score - lower is better), shown bottom left | live | FB68 (STA) | F62C (LDA)<br>FB68 (LDA) |
| $83 | MONSTERS_HERE | monsters in the player's room (or the doorway's other room); while not 0 you can't light a match, a lit one blows out, and lightning may flash | live | F141 (STA)<br>F8AC (INC, STA) | F155 (LDA)<br>F2B7 (LDA)<br>F59E (LDA)<br>F62C (LDA)<br>F8AC (INC)<br>FB68 (LDA) |
| $84 | COLOUR_CYCLE | bit 4 set: attract mode - the colours drift; the rest counts every 256 frames | code | F141 (STA)<br>F2B7 (INC, STA) | F2B7 (INC, LDA) |
| $85 | MONSTER_SHOWN | which monster was drawn this frame (one per frame, in turn); the last slot shows the stairs | code | F141 (STA)<br>F194 (STA)<br>F57D (STX)<br>F59E (STX) | F57D (CPX, LDX)<br>FA90 (LDA) |
| $86 | ITEM_SHOWN | which item was drawn this frame (one per frame, in turn) | live | F526 (STX) | F4F1 (CPX, LDX)<br>FA90 (CMP, LDA) |
| $87 | SECOND_COUNTER | counts down 60 frames, then the match loses a second. Runs all the time and is not reset when a match is lit, so a match's first second is 1-60 frames (256 for the first match after RESET, which clears it to 0) | live | F155 (DEC, STA) | F155 (DEC) |
| $88 | DOORWAY | bit 7 = in a doorway now; low bits = its direction (0 left, 1 right, 2 up, 3 down), kept after you leave it | live | FC3C (STA, STY) | F2B7 (BIT)<br>FC3C (BIT, CMP) |
| $89 | CLOCK | frame counter, +1 every frame | live | F000 (INC)<br>F155 (STA) | F000 (INC)<br>F2B7 (AND, LDA)<br>F62C (LDA)<br>F8AC (LDA) |
